steps.en: Install the CLI and give it one model key
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，给它一个模型 key

steps.en: Describe the agent in one YAML — model, instruction, toolsets
steps.zh: 用一个 YAML 写清 agent：模型、指令、工具集

steps.en: Runs the loop, executes file/shell/MCP tools, pausing for your approval per call
steps.zh: 跑循环、执行文件/shell/MCP 工具，每次调用停下等你批准

steps.en: Delegates tasks to the sub-agents in the same config and merges their results
steps.zh: 把任务委派给配置里的子 agent，再合并结果

steps.en: Publish the config like an image
steps.zh: 像推镜像一样发布这个配置

steps.en: Anyone with the CLI runs your agent straight from the registry
steps.zh: 装了这个 CLI 的人直接从 registry 拉起来跑

value.en: A working multi-tool agent from one versionable file — no glue code, no server — and that file is already a shareable artifact
value.zh: 一个可版本化的文件就是一个能用多工具的 agent——不用胶水代码、不用服务器——它本身已是可分享的构件

sources: README.md (docker/docker-agent, 2026-09-28): Install section — `brew install docker-agent`, `export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...`; Quick Start — `docker agent run agent.yaml`, `docker agent run myorg/agent:tag`
docs/getting-started/quickstart/index.md (Option D): minimal agent.yaml with model/instruction/toolsets
docs/tools/shell/index.md: shell commands 'require user confirmation unless --yolo is used'
docs/concepts/multi-agent/index.md: parent calls `transfer_task`, child runs in a sub-session, results flow back
